# Cards inventory

## Base

base: f08cf41f2c80e2e4f7ab834adc3dc06820ae7f93

Method: one row per behaviour of the old cards at the base, from the per-family inventories of
children 19 to 24, merged by a script, plus `X` rows for the rules no family listed.
Sources: `git ls-tree -r <base> -- skills` and `git show <base>:<path>` (LF bytes).
Homes and checks are read against the head under test; `open:` marks a row with none yet,
each listed in `docs/proofs/cards-inventory-open.tsv`.
Cross-checks, not sources: the rails of `evals/SCORECARD.md`, `moved_rules.tsv` at the base and
the tables of CR-471.

## Sources

Left out: the wrappers of `agents/` and `com.github.copilot/agents/` (not removed; `just roles` checks them). The JSON files are `code` lines: the two host files are the same at the head, `topics.json` grew with the new cards' topics.
